motivation: earnings_continuation_A_v1 (open-to-close same-day, H1) was FALSIFIED at the primary 2% threshold (t=1.45 < 1.5). However H2 (close[t] to close[t+1]) was strong (t=3.14) and directionally consistent at all three thresholds. This program asks a narrower question: does a realistic single trade entered at the earnings-day open and held through the next session's close capture that persistence, rather than requiring an unimplementable same-day round trip.

integrity.historical_holdout_status: CONSUMED; no date in historical storage may be presented as fresh validation
integrity.development_period: 2001-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (full history; characterization exercise, not a holdout test)
integrity.forward_validation: Prospective paper track only if the falsification criteria below are met. Do not build a composite or paper track and do not consume holdout data as part of this program.
integrity.reuses_data_from: earnings_continuation_A_v1 run 20260910T153202Z_ae1d4ed42b (events.csv). No new signal-eligibility decision is made after seeing that run's H1/H2 results; this program only changes the execution window applied to the already-computed gap/return fields, and that execution window (open-to-next-close) is fixed before this file is used to compute anything.

economic_hypothesis: Same as earnings_continuation_A_v1: the earnings-day gap direction reflects information-driven repricing that continues, rather than reverses. This variant tests whether that continuation is capturable as a single realistic trade (enter at the earnings-day open, hold through the next session's close) rather than requiring the same-day open-to-close round trip that A_v1 tested and did not clear its bar.

signal_definition.formula: earnings_gap = (open[t] - close[t-1]) / close[t-1], identical to earnings_continuation_A_v1

signal_direction.long_signal: buy stocks with earnings_gap > +threshold at the earnings-day open
signal_direction.avoid_signal: do not hold / consider short stocks with earnings_gap < -threshold at the earnings-day open

universe: Identical to earnings_continuation_A_v1 (same eligibility filters, same anchor-day event definition).

execution.entry: Alpaca intraday open, first 15-minute bar at/after 09:30 ET, on the earnings anchor day (same open price used for H1 in the parent program)
execution.exit: Sharadar daily close of the next trading session (close[t+1]) -- i.e. the same close used for H2 in the parent program
execution.coverage_constraint: Only computable where Alpaca H1 coverage exists (same ~3.9% overall coverage as the parent program, concentrated 2020-07-27 onward); no imputation or substitution of the daily open for missing Alpaca coverage.

cost_model.note: Same ADV-tiered cost assumption as the parent program, applied once per trade (entry+exit) rather than twice, since this is a single overnight-inclusive holding period rather than same-day round trip plus a separate next-day round trip.

factor_model.specification: FF5 + UMD (6-factor) on the daily return_A_prime series, aggregated by entry date
factor_model.caveat: This return spans an intraday session plus one overnight gap; daily close-to-close factors are an approximation, same caveat as H2/H3/H4 in the parent program.

falsification_criteria.ADVANCE: return_A_prime long-minus-short spread t > 2.0 at the primary (2%) threshold AND directionally consistent (same sign) at 1% and 3%
falsification_criteria.SECONDARY: spread t between 1.5 and 2.0 with correct direction, or t > 2.0 at only one non-primary threshold
falsification_criteria.FALSIFIED: spread t < 1.5 or wrong direction at the primary threshold

multiple_testing.note: Same family-wise correction as the parent program; applies to claiming any single threshold as independently significant.

constraints: Preregistration committed before any return_A_prime value is computed or read.

Reuses the already-computed events.csv fields (alpaca_open_adjusted, close_fwd_H2, earnings_gap) from earnings_continuation_A_v1's completed run; does not re-query the source databases or change any eligibility filter.
Winsorize return_A_prime at 1st/99th percentile, independent of the parent program's H1/H2 winsorization.
Minimum 20 events per bucket per sub-group to report that cell; fewer than 20 is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
Report all three thresholds regardless of which passes.
Do not start building a composite or paper track until characterization is complete and reviewed.
Do not read or modify any existing paper-trading state file or ledger as part of this research.
